_readme: Every file the tests and test tools use that is NOT part of this repository,
kept in one place so paths can be updated without touching test code.
Resolution (test/external-assets.js): the entry's env var, when set, wins;
otherwise the first existing path in `paths` is used (top to bottom).
Paths may start with ~ (home directory) or be repo-relative.
Tests SKIP with a note when an asset is missing — except the ROMs, which
most of the suite cannot run without (all-test.js checks them up front).
`link` says where an asset can be obtained; each remains under its own
copyright/license and is not distributed with this repository.
